# Visual Semantics

Choose visuals by meaning.

Mapping rules:
- cause/effect -> arrow
- sequence -> path
- timeline -> chronology
- hierarchy -> tree
- comparison -> side_by_side
- process -> pipeline
- category -> cluster
- data -> graph
- definition -> keyword plus callout
- formula -> isolated draw sequence
- example -> boxed illustration

Never add arrows or diagrams as decoration.
If a visual does not improve understanding, remove it.
